mapper.select: select n.*, u.real_name as publisher_name from oa_notice n left join sys_user u on n.publisher_id = u.id order by n.is_top desc, n.publish_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_notice(title, content, publisher_id, is_top, status, publish_time) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{publisherId}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{publishTime})
mapper.update: update oa_notice set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_top = #{isTop}, status = #{status}, publish_time = #{publishTime} where id = #{id}
